title: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation Enters Into Application
detail: The EU's Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) began applying across all 27 member states, replacing the 1994 directive's patchwork of national transpositions with the bloc's first directly-binding, harmonised packaging rules. The initial phase restricts packaging containing PFAS ('forever chemicals') above strict concentration limits from food-contact materials and requires manufacturers to minimise hazardous substances in packaging composition. Further phased requirements follow through 2040, including harmonised waste-sorting labelling from 2028 and mandatory recyclability, minimum recycled-content, and single-use plastic restrictions from 2030.
